issue: Serving primary reported six observed workers while all ten auxiliary-PC workers were active.
causes: The primary could not read the auxiliary PC metrics endpoint directly.
The initial relay receiver check ran nginx -t as root, which changed private temp-directory ownership away from the service account and caused upload failures.
fix: Homeserver relays only four allowlisted numeric PC observations, preserving the original PC timestamp.
Primary reads that relay through a separate source-restricted exact receiver path.
Private temp directories belong to www-data with mode 0700; the metrics unit validates nginx configuration as its own service user.
